notes: ἔτι τε καί is read as three separate items — *yea* on ἔτι, *and* on τε, *also* on καί — the ASV writing a word for each under rules 70 and 65; reading *and* as the καί's with an unrepresented τε under rule 70's one-conjunction arm remains defensible.

The articles of the coordinated nouns after the first are unrepresented under rule 23 because the ASV writes no determiner for them at all; the two articles whose nouns carry *his own* are unrepresented under rule 20.
ἑαυτοῦ → *his own* is headed on *his*, the reflexive being a pronoun that *his* spells while *own* is the supplied intensifier — rule 107's personal-pronoun arm rather than its intensive-αὐτός arm.
